preregistered_analyses.y: recorded individual Change (verify sign and exact agreement with Post-Pre first; negative signifies fewer line crosses after cue)
preregistered_analyses.factors: Conditioning stage (larval/adult/water) × test cue (larval/adult), separately by predator species
preregistered_analyses.experimental_unit: 18 independently conditioned Pail IDs per predator experiment; individual test responses are nested in Pail, Clutch mapping audited but not counted as extra units.
preregistered_analyses.contrast1: For each clutch, pooled mean cross-stage response (larval-trained adult-cue and adult-trained larval-cue) minus same-test-cue sham-trained control, equal weight across two directions
preregistered_analyses.contrast2: For each clutch, same-stage response (larval-trained larval-cue and adult-trained adult-cue) minus same-test-cue sham-trained controls; compare within-clutch to contrast1
preregistered_analyses.fallback_if_missing_clutch_crossing: source-grain issue; use stratum aggregation with no inferential p value and explicitly report incomplete crossover
preregistered_analyses.uncertainty: Stratified conditioning-Pail bootstrap (6 pails per train treatment) over equal-pail group means, 10,000 deterministic draws seeded 20261025, 2.5%/97.5% percentile interval. NOT an exact randomized test.
sensitivity: source metadata 21 Beetle pail×clutch cells vs 18 actual conditioning pails
all actual measurement rows vs paper-protocol n discrepancy
preregistered_analyses.multiplicity: Two systems and three estimands are exploratory, not fully confirmatory; no favorable outcome fishing

scientific_hypotheses: Prediction: beetle early/late odor cross-stage trained-vs-sham risk response is negative in both reciprocal directions.
Prediction: salamander cross-stage trained-vs-sham transfer is weaker or absent, while within-stage conditioning yields negative response.
Alternative: any differences reflect odor concentration/prey experience or cohort selection; not causal phylogenetic generality.
claim_ceilings: chemical cues not frog advertisement/acoustic warning
2 independently conducted predator-condition experiments, not 588 independent studies
predator identity reset does not mean predator-prey attack direction switches
source/publication counts must not be silently reconciled
next_macro_bridge: stage-dependent information-transfer indicator under within-study physically distinct predator groups, not pooled comparable attack-rate

schema_audit_amendment_before_outcome.reason: Original published experiment randomization at conditioning Pail; source shows 18 distinct Pail IDs for each experiment. Beetle sheet contains 21 distinct Pail×Clutch cells across those 18 pails; Clutch is NOT a valid unique independent conditioning-unit identifier.
schema_audit_amendment_before_outcome.analysis_unit_repaired: Pail, not Pail×Clutch; means per Pail×test cue, equal Pail weighting and condition-label clustering. Clutch remains an audit/sensitivity variable, not independent replicate.
schema_audit_amendment_before_outcome.bootstrap: resample complete pails within each conditioning treatment at original n=6 per treatment, 10k deterministic bootstrap draws, readout percentiles and leave-one-pail-out influence; no individual iid standard error.
schema_audit_amendment_before_outcome.model: within-sheet independent conditioning pails; no cross-paper/multi-clade pseudoreplication; bootstrapped ratio of frozen factor contrasts

source_only_second_amendment.discovery: Published original Salamader sheet has 17 complete Pail×test-cue pairs among 18 conditioning pails. Exactly one sham-conditioned Pail has larval test-cue records but no adult test-cue observations. Beetle 18/18 conditioning pails complete. Verified BEFORE opening any source response effect values.
source_only_second_amendment.analysis_repair: Primary uses all available pail×cue cells with explicit changing denominators: sham-adult 5 pails, sham-larval 6, all other treatment-cue group cells 6. Stratified pail bootstrap samples intact pail records (including missing cue), skipping zero-eligible-cue draws rather than inventing missing response.
source_only_second_amendment.prespecified_sensitivity: Repeat complete-pail-only analysis where sham larval count is reduced from 6 to 5; report signed difference from primary. Do not assume unobserved sham adult outcome was zero.
limits: Some original tests not in public workbook; no assertion their missingness is random
No causal comparison of species taxon mechanism independent of predator physiology/odor concentration
